facts.ownership_contract: Abstract_Summoned_Entity is PathfinderMob/OwnableEntity, not TamableAnimal/AnimationPet. Tame is flag bit 4; native nullable UUID field initializes empty. tame(Player) sets tame and UUID; canAttack excludes resolved native owner, wantsToAttack always true, tame getTeam/isAlliedTo delegate to resolved owner then parent. Native OwnableEntity owner lookup is left authoritative; no substitute owner/entity cache is added.
facts.persistence_contract: Save writes Owner UUID if present and LifeTicks only when limited-life flag is set. Load accepts UUID or old-user conversion; non-null UUID sets owner and tame(true,false), caught Throwable sets tame(false,true). No UUID leaves constructor state. Limited life setter accepts its integer without clamping; server parent-first tick predecrements and discards at <=0. This is discard, not damage/death/respawner. Concrete sword NBT delegates only; no owner-dead or owner-missing automatic discard is added.
facts.target_contract: Summoner hurt-by and hurt-target goals require tame, resolved owner, a changed corresponding timestamp, native TargetGoal canAttack(DEFAULT) and wantsToAttack. Start assigns target, snapshots owner timestamp if still resolved, then native parent start. Sword also registers HurtByTarget alert-others and native MeleeAttackGoal(speed 1,long memory true).
facts.follow_contract: Sword binds FlyingFollowSummonerGoal(speed1,min25,max2,leaves=false). Start needs non-spectator owner, squared distance>=min^2, !combat and shouldFollow=true. Continue tests !combat and squared distance>max^2 without an added navigation-done/shouldFollow check. Combat means owner distance<30 plus alive target. Every10 ticks, if not leashed/passenger, owner distanceSquared>=144 tries up to10 teleports (XZ +/-3,Y +/-1), THEN still invokes IFollower.followEntity -> native navigation moveTo. Teleport rejects near-owner X/Z, accepts AIR+noCollision or WALKABLE+leaf/noCollision checks. Parent separate teleport API uses WALKABLE, 10 attempts and canFlyToOwner=false; it is not a registered additional goal.
facts.setup_motion_contract: Sword extends the compiled summoned base. Native FlyingMoveControl(20,true) and FlyingPathNavigation(openDoors=false,float=true,passDoors=true). Attribute helper defines follow30, move0.25, fly1.25, attack4, health28, armor3,KBR1; this supplier has no native registration binding. Attack bounding box inflates parent by (0.5,0,0.5), remaining native melee reach/cooldown/LOS stays native. checkFallDamage is empty and onClimbable=false; other incoming defenses remain inherited, with no proven type fire immunity. Locally controlled travel uses water input0.02F/drag0.8F, lava input0.02F/drag0.5, air friction0.91F and on-ground native block friction with 0.16277137F/f^3 and ground input0.1F; SELF movement, no generic knockback rewrite.
facts.locked_melee_status_contract: Reuse the already captured doHurtTarget witness without regeneration: broadcasts native event4 before calling parent Mob.doHurtTarget; false native return exits false, accepted hit on LivingEntity requests Blazing Brand(duration100, implicit amplifier0, source=sword), ignores effect-add return and returns true. Native damage actor remains sword, with native attack/enchantment/knockback/post-hit pipeline. Event4 only chooses client presentation animation; tick/aiStep add no second damage callback. Locked Blazing Brand attribute/status semantics remain unchanged.
